title: Dardo agrees to try a tap dancers' night
summary: Green tells the producer about the Apollo tap nights and promises to bring in dancers; Dardo advertises the Monday-night show.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: And so, I told Mr. Dardo, I said, "Well, maybe I mean you can give it a try. I mean you don't have to do it." I said, "Well, they got extra audiences come up to the Apollo Theater when they would advertise about the tap dancers night, you see. Which was on a Tuesday up there, see." But we did a series of them. And once time we had to do an extra show.

So, that's what got it to the public's attention. And as I say now, Jazz is a happy medium. And the tourists, especially student bodies, they always want to be studious throughout the rest of their lives, you know. Like
they say, dads and grads, right.

Well, he said, 'Well, if you say so,' he says, 'I'm going to take a chance on it.' And he said, 'Do you -- who do you want to help you? Do you know who to get to help you.' And I said, 'Well, yeah. I can get most of them. I think I can reunite them, you know. Most of them,' I said. 'Some of them has gone west, you know, out on the coast. I don't know about we can get them to come in, you know. They may be in other commitments. Some of them went to the Morocco Club, you see, in Canada even.' I said, 'But I think I can get enough of them to support themselves.' (clears his throat). Pardon me please.

"So, I'll bring them down, you know, and give you an idea. We'll just try it out and you'll see." So, he got right onto the publication of it, see. He put up advertising there, and publication in the papers in the lobby, you know. As the audience comes out, they can see what's going to happen on these -- this other Monday night.
